events.title: Employee is fatally injured by powered industrial truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Executive Dodge Inc. Wallingford, CT. At 2:30 p.m. on January 10, 2025, Employee #1 was loading a crate of parts into a tractor trailer using a CAT powered industrial truck (PIT) at a worksite. The CAT PIT unexpectedly rolled forward, trapping Employee #1 between the PIT and the rear of the tractor trailer. The employee suffered fatalinjuries.

At approximately 11:30 a.m. on September 1, 2015, an employee was removing 12-2 metal clad (MC) wire from a 2-ft by 4-ft recessed light. The employee turned off the wrong 20 amp circuit breaker at the panel. The circuit was connected to a four way light switch. The employee assumed the circuit was de-energized because it did not test positive for an electric current. An unknown person in another part of the facility turned on the light at a different location which energized the 277 volt/20 amp…

events.title: Employee is killed when saw kicks back
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Manafort Brothers Inc. Stratford, CT. At approximately 8:30 a.m. on June 25, 2015, Employee #1 was using a concrete saw, Sthil model TS420, to cut an iron water pipeline. He was bending over and standing directly behind the saw when the saw kicked back, striking him in the neck. Employee #1 sustained a laceration to his neck and died.

events.title: Employee found face down in the water and is killed by drown…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Blakeslee Arpaia Chapman Inc. New Haven, CT. At approximately 10:30 p.m. on June 16, 2015, Employee #1, a foreman, retrieved some welding rods for a coworker who was welding on a run out. Employee #1 moved onto a float on the water to hand the rods to the welder and Employee #1 was later found face down in the water.

events.title: Employee Is Killed When Run Over By Garbage Truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Winter Bros. Waste Systems Of Ct, Llc. Danbury, CT. At 6:50 a.m. on May 13, 2015, an employee was walking or running behind a garbage truck that was backing up to a transfer station to unload its load of garbage. The employee was struck by and run over by the garbage truck, crushing his entire body and killing him.

events.title: Employee falls from top of crane cab, strikes head, and is k…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: O & G Industries, Inc. / Tutor Perini Corporation, A Joint Venture. New Haven, CT. At 2:05 p.m. on May 2,. 2015, an employee was operating a 1972 American 7260 lattice boom crawler crane to move moving bundles of rebar. The employee shut down the crane and was on top of the crane's cab when he fell down 11 feet and 10 inches. As the employee fell, he struck his head hit against the crane's counterweight and then fell to the ground. Employee died from blunt impact injury to the head.

events.title: Employee Is Shot And Killed By Robbers
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: S & R Enterprise Llc. New Haven, CT. At approximately 7:30 p.m. on April 6, 2015, Employee #1, a sales clerk, was working at a convenience store/gas station. While he was working, two individuals came into the station and robbed him. As they left, they shot and killed him.

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by dump truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Tolland, CT. At 11:15 on March 19, 2015, an employee was patching potholes. The employee wasstruck by dump truck that was backing up. The employee was killed from injuries to the ribs, spinal cord, arm, and leg.

events.title: An employee receives electric shock and falls from ladder wh…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Rp Remodeling, Llc. Newington, CT. At 10:15 p.m. on January 21, 2105, an employee was carrying a piece of aluminum flashing up a ladder. The victim lost control of the flashing in the windy conditions. The flashing contacted the adjacent energized power line. The victim was electrically shocked which caused him to fall approximately 18 feet from the ladder. Employee succumbed to injuries and died.
